text.en:
Implementing Agency. The IA shall be responsible for the
implementation of the programs
disbursements/expenditures shall be subject to applicable laws and budgeting,
accounting and auditing rules and regulations.
For recording purposes, the DBM shall authorize the IA to open and
maintain a SAG for the amounts released pursuant to this Executive Order (EO).
In case the IA is a Local Government Unit, the SAG shall be issued to DBM; and
if the IA is a Government Owned or Controlled Corporation, the SAGF shall be
issued to the BTr.

Repealing Clause. All EOs, rules, regulations and other
issuances or parts thereof, which are inconsistent with the provisions of this E0,
are hereby repealed or modified accordingly.

Effectivity. This EO shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 13th day of October, in the year of Our
Lord, Two Thousand and Nine.
please in Ring
By the President:
EDUARDO R. ERMITA
Executive Secretary
